editorial:
Imagine if Frankenstein's monster had children, but they grew into giant monsters that could flatten entire cities. That is exactly what you get here. You follow the story of Gaira, a mean sea creature who loves to eat people and cause chaos in Tokyo. Just when things look bleak, his brother Sanda comes down from the mountains. Sanda is much nicer and wants to stop his brother from hurting everyone. The whole vibe feels like a classic monster brawl from the sixties, mixing scary moments with huge scale action that keeps you wondering who will win the fight.

You will really love the fight scenes between the two giants, as they feel heavy and powerful. While some of the human acting is a bit stiff, the monster effects are great for the time. The pacing is quick, though some of the military scenes drag a little. If you are into giant monster fights, you should definitely check this out. I suggest adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture, or you can just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a massive fight between the two brothers in the middle of the city. Sanda manages to beat Gaira, but the military steps in to finish the job. They use a powerful rocket weapon to blow Gaira into tiny pieces. After the battle, Sanda realizes he cannot stay in the city and heads back to the mountains. The world is safe for now, but the city is left in total ruins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves giant monster movies and retro special effects.
